newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV THRASH RODA TO STAY TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV THRASH RODA TO STAY TOP.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven scored the biggest win of the Dutch first division season on Saturday, thrashing Roda JC Kerkrade 8-0 to stay on top of the table.
In a perfect dress rehearsal for Thursday's Cup Winners Cup tie against Brann Bergen of Norway, 2-1 winners in the first leg, the Roda defence was under pressure from the start.
PSV skipper Arthur Numan opened the score after seven minutes, with Boudewijn Zenden and Vampeta making it 3-0 before half-time.
In the second-half, Marciano Vink, Luc Nilis, Zenden, Marcelo and Zeljko Petrovic all added to the tally, many of them set up by midfielder Wim Jonk who had a superb match.
Second-placed Feyenoord remain one point behind, courtesy of an injury-time penalty which edged out Utrecht 2-1.
Feyenoord were the better side, although the match remained goalless until the final 15 minutes.

In the 76th minute Henk Vos lobbed the ball over Utrecht goalkeeper Rene Ponk on a Larsson pass, only for Leon van Nieuwkerk to equalise a minute later, converting a rebound after Jean-Paul de Jong's shot had hit a post.
When a Ronald Koeman shot then hit an Utrecht hand in the box in injury-time, Feyenoord seized their chance with Koeman making no mistake from the spot.
The results put extra pressure on struggling Ajax Amsterdam, now trailing PSV by 10 points. The Amsterdammers visit Vitesse Arnhem on Sunday.
